name: factorio-research-queue-for-space_age
title: Extended Research Queue
author: cmnielsen
description: WARNING: Version 1.0.1 and newer require Factorio 2.1. If you play Factorio 2.0.77 or older, use version 1.0.0 of this mod. An improved GUI for managing the research queue, with filtering, translated search, queue controls, research time estimates and prerequisite information. Inspired by the earlier mods Extended Research Queue (sh4dow) and Research Queue (sonaxaton).
